title: The FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: Matchday 6’s Best XI features Henderson, Anderson, and Rice
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutTV schedulesThe FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: Matchday 6’s Best XI features Henderson, Anderson, and RiceShareAfter a three-week hiatus due to the recent international break, matchday six is finally finished, with Manchester City maintaining their 100% record and a three-point advantage at the top of the Premier League table.
The Italian was in imperious form against Liverpool, making six saves in total across the 90 minutes as his side triumphed 3-0.
He also succeeded with 100% of his ground and aerial duels, while succeeding with his only dribble attempt and this marks his second inclusion in FotMob’s Team of the Week already this season.
Ouattara was making just his second Premier League start for Ipswich at the weekend, yet the defender ended up scoring the equaliser against Fulham in the dying minutes.
Furthermore, the youngster also made four passes into the final third, wasn’t dispossessed and registered four defensive contributions throughout the clash.
While Ouattara brought Ipswich back level against the Cottagers, it was centre-back Dara O’Shea who netted the winner with just seconds left on the clock.
His header gave Ipswich all three points, but it was his defensive display which justifies the defender making it into the TOTW.
Indeed, he made nine defensive contributions along with seven recoveries, while the Irishman took 76 touches throughout, indicating that he was aiming to control the game from the back.
His rating of 8.2 is the best of any defender in the league this weekend.
Bobby Thomas registered a staggering 22 defensive contributions in the 4-1 win against Newcastle United, the most of any player on the field (does anyone have him in their FPL team?).
There were 16 clearances among that total, showcasing his ability to consistently repel opposition attacks.
Thomas was also keen on getting his side going in the final third, making nine passes into this area as he too celebrates making it into the TOTW for the second time this season.
Calafiori came to Arsenal’s rescue against Leeds, netting the equaliser a few minutes after the Yorkshire side took the lead.

That was his second goal of the season and for a left-back, his attacking stats weren’t bad at all, creating two big chances, registering two shots and taking four touches in the opposition penalty area.
He will be vital for Mikel Arteta this term, especially given Arsenal’s issues at left-back in recent seasons.
Jordan Henderson rolled back the years in Chelsea’s 5-1 thrashing of Bournemouth. The Englishman not only scored twice and provided an assist, but he also took the joint-most shots (3) of anyone.

Despite his age, Henderson managed 79 touches, signifying that he was still looking to get on the ball as much as possible and he even covered the most distance across both teams (11.9km) during the game.
For his display, he received a 9.2 FotMob rating – the highest in this week’s TOTW.
Anderson is another regular in our TOTW and he is certainly filling the void left by Rodri at Manchester City.
The midfielder dictated the tempo of the game, having the most touches (104) of any player, while also covering the most distance (11.4km) in the match.
